title: Selective chemical looping combustion of acetylene in ethylene-rich streams | Science
content: The requirement for C2H2 concentrations below 2 parts per million (ppm) in gas streams for C2H4 polymerization necessitates its semihydrogenation to C2H4. We demonstrate selective chemical looping combustion of C2H2 in C2H4-rich streams by Bi2O3 as an ...
